caption: The drawing depicts a single large ceramic jar with a wide round body tapering to a narrower, slightly flared mouth and a flat, stable base. The color of the jar is predominantly a warm brownish-tan, with subtle mottling and variations in tone that suggest a roughened, natural clay texture. The surface features decorative inscriptions in uppercase block letters along the top half, reading "LIBERTY HOF" and "WARNE LETTIS 1801 / AMBOY N.JERSY." Just below the text, there is a simple decorative motif resembling a pair of wings or leaves, shaded in grayish-blue. The jar is centered on a plain, light beige background with slight discoloration around the edges. There are minimal adornments or objects apart from the jar itself, and the boundaries of the paper are visible, the artist's name "Francis Law Durand" is printed in small letters in the lower right corner.
title: Jug
